chunks: Know that the loss of anything of this world will not harm you, if you have guarded the principles of your religion.
Know also that after the loss of your religion nothing of this world for which you have cared will benefit you.
May Allāh carry our hearts and your hearts towards the right and may He grant us and you endurance.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between preserving religion and worldly losses according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali delivers this concise yet profound maxim to highlight the eschatological weight of faith, asserting that the preservation of religious integrity (Qiyamat al-Din) is the ultimate metric of success, rendering worldly losses negligible. This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on spiritual resilience during political turmoil, where maintaining doctrinal purity outweighs temporal power. The concluding supplication underscores the divine source of this wisdom, linking human agency with God's inspiration (Ilham) for steadfastness.
